title: Chronometer
copy: Celestial computation, transit geometry and field alignment. The Guild’s public instrument remains online under civilian observation.
signal: The machine does not predict. It measures relation.

title: The Film
copy: A feature-length temporal event assembled across live performance, dome projection, testimony and recovered records.
signal: A film is a machine for remembering an event that has not yet happened.

title: Commons
copy: The social layer: local chapters, witnesses, operators, travellers, archivists and accidental participants.
signal: No one enters the Guild alone, even when they arrive by themselves.

title: Calendar
copy: Observed conjunctions, departures, public sessions, Guild meetings, eclipse windows and unclaimed dates.
signal: Some dates are appointments. Others are coordinates.

title: Archive
copy: Documents, minutes, photographs, reports, corrections and evidence that should not exist in the same timeline.
signal: Contradiction is not error. It is evidence of overlap.

title: Stations
copy: Physical sites and temporary embassies distributed through Wales and elsewhere. Each station keeps its own clock.
signal: Every station is local. The network is not.

title: Research
copy: Papers, falsifiable models, astronomical mechanics, narrative geometry and the mathematics beneath the instruments.

title: Missions
copy: Small actions in ordinary places. Some are public. Some only become visible when several records are compared.
signal: A mission is a story with its destination removed.

title: People
copy: Thousands of partial biographies, affiliations, encounters and traces. No single person contains the whole story.
signal: The cast is the world. The world is not background.

title: Signals
copy: Audio fragments, coded broadcasts, public notices, machine outputs and transmissions without an agreed sender.
signal: Every signal is also an invitation to misread it.

title: Elsewhen
copy: Pages not yet attached to a stable chronology. Some may belong to 2033. Some may only appear to.
signal: Elsewhen is not another time. It is time without permission.
